value: 30 Apr long plan (not taken): 4h bullish, 1h bearish, so use the 15m. Price swept a low (NQ tagged 17791.25 at ≈08:30), then made a 15m break of structure up at the open, then retraced to equilibrium (≈17842.50). He then waited for a 5m (or 15m) break of structure up for entry. He judged the confluence not good enough, and price instead broke down after ≈10:45.

1 May short plan (not taken, FOMC day): higher timeframe bearish. At the NY open price ran the morning highs (NQ ≈17,518, ES ≈5,062), then made a 15m break of structure down. Wait for price to retrace into a 15m breaker aligned with an FVG (his 'unicorn model'; NQ red 17491.25, ES red 5051.50 / grey box ≈5,053-5,055) or an order block. Enter on a 5m break of structure down. Target the sell-side liquidity at the morning lows (NQ 17412.00; ES ≈5,038). Stop placement not stated.
An hourly break of structure down on 1 May would open lower hourly lows (NQ ≈17,300-17,320, the 25 Apr low area; ES near 5034.00).

quality_notes: No trades, so no entry/stop/target or P&L to verify. The main limit is the transcript: it is badly garbled, so the setup sequence and the 'conditions' come from fragments matched to chart drawings; for example, 30 Apr is unclear on whether the 4h low was his entry sweep or his target. The 1 May plan has no stated stop or entry price and was recorded before FOMC, so its outcome after 11:30 ET isn't shown. Prices other than axis/legend labels are estimated from candle positions (±2-3 ES pts, ±5-15 NQ pts, ±10-15 min). Several labels are crosshair readings, not drawn levels, and are marked as such. The crypto section (≈4 min) is emotional commentary with no testable plan.
